value.rationale: The complete four-dimensional binary Fourier aperture is a canonical individual-array merit-factor model; an exact sharp bound plus all 384 optimal signs is a natural structural classification. Demonstrating optimality of the standard path construction rather than mere attainability is valuable, and its extension to every quadratic graph on up to seven variables supplies a nontrivial fully reproducible cutoff. The weighted induced-Eulerian formula provides an explanatory bridge from Fourier analysis to graph structure; neither downstream applications nor unrestricted higher-dimensional claims are required.
